title: ever RUBY|Convertible Chiffon Lace Open Back Spaghetti Straps Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a statement in our elegant lace and chiffon bridesmaid dress. Featuring spaghetti straps and an open back, this convertible dress is perfect for any wedding. The delicate lace detailing adds a touch of romance, while the flowing chiffon skirt is both comfortable and flattering. Available in a range of colors, this dress is the perfect choice for any bridesmaid.


Fit: Please refer to the size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
